description: The byte-identical call from `call-not-in-logic-context-pos`, wrapped in an explicit `${ ... }` logic block — does NOT fire E-CALL-NOT-IN-LOGIC-CONTEXT. The `${}` wrapper is the ONLY delta between the two cases, so the pair brackets the call/logic-context boundary exactly.
rationale: §40.8 S368 amendment names this as THE fix verbatim: "A call is logic; wrap it in `${...}`: `${ loadData() }`." Inside a logic block a call is in its proper context, so the code SHALL stay silent. This NEG also pins the amendment's scope discrimination: the diagnostic fires at the IMMEDIATE default-logic body-top ONLY — a call inside an explicit user-written `${...}` block is outside the fire region, exactly as the `write-not-in-logic-context-neg` sibling pins for writes.
